milestone_brief:
notebook-bm25-isolation-m1 — Per-notebook BM25 index root (fork-C startup collision)

The follow-up filed by notebook-cutover-m1's F1 (HIGH). Read that critique first:
.claude/notes/milestones/notebook-cutover-m1/critique-merged.md (F1, lines 28-37).

PROBLEM. The BM25 index root is GLOBAL and keyed ONLY by the per-dataset MVCC version
integer: BM25_INDEX_ROOT = var/arxmcp/index/bm25/ and bm25_index_dir(version) ->
BM25_INDEX_ROOT / f"v{version}" (ingest/bm25_indexer.py:104,114). Fork-C
(ARXMCP_NOTEBOOK=<slug>) serves a per-notebook corpus: the config model-validator
derive_notebook_lancedb_path rewrites lancedb_path to var/arxmcp/notebooks/<slug>/lancedb
(server/config.py:98-118), and the cache is isolated too (cache_db_path,
notebooks_db_path). BUT the BM25 root is NOT isolated — it stays the global
var/arxmcp/index/bm25/v<N>/. So a notebook (e.g. shimura at v49) and the shared corpus
(or another notebook) at the same version integer N COLLIDE on bm25/vN/. Fork-C startup
(server/resources.py BM25Phase.startup, ~:407-413) loads bm25/vN/bm25.pkl and
cross-checks its chunk_ids against the LIVE (notebook) LanceDB table (E07_S01 F4); a
collision makes the notebook unbootable (chunk_id mismatch) or serves the wrong index /
phantom candidates.

FIX. Isolate the BM25 root per-notebook — the BM25 analog of the existing fork-C
lancedb_path / cache_db_path isolation. For fork-C the BM25 root should live under the
notebook's own tree (e.g. var/arxmcp/notebooks/<slug>/index/bm25/v<N>/), derived the same
way derive_notebook_lancedb_path rewrites lancedb_path. The shared (non-notebook) server
keeps the global var/arxmcp/index/bm25/v<N>/ root UNCHANGED.

LIKELY SEAMS (researchers verify CURRENT file:line):
- ingest/bm25_indexer.py: BM25_INDEX_ROOT (:104), bm25_index_dir(version) (:114),
  build_bm25_index (:245) — must accept/derive a configurable root, not hardcode the
  global constant.
- server/config.py: add a bm25_index_root field (default the global root), rewritten by
  the fork-C model-validator alongside lancedb_path (mirror derive_notebook_lancedb_path,
  :98-118).
- server/resources.py + server/retrieval (BM25Phase.startup, ~:407-413): derive the BM25
  root from config so fork-C loads/builds under the notebook root.
- Confirm whether the eval/CLI build paths (tools/, ingest CLIs) that call
  build_bm25_index need the root threaded too.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- A fork-C server (ARXMCP_NOTEBOOK=<slug>) loads/builds its BM25 index under the
  notebook's OWN root (var/arxmcp/notebooks/<slug>/index/bm25/v<N>/), NOT the global root.
- The shared (non-notebook) server uses the global var/arxmcp/index/bm25/v<N>/ root,
  unchanged (no regression to the existing shared-corpus path).
- Regression test: two datasets at the SAME version integer N (shared + notebook, or two
  notebooks) resolve to DIFFERENT BM25 roots — no collision, no chunk_id cross-check
  failure. MUST fail on the pre-fix global-root code.
- EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 + EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256 UNCHANGED (no MCP tool surface change);
  no CHUNKER_VERSION bump; make test green.

CONSTRAINTS: local-first; no new dependency; assert banned for invariants in server/+ingest/;
pure-ASGI only (n/a here). Optionally note whether notebook_cutover.py can now safely
re-add the per-notebook BM25 build (was removed by F1) — but that re-add is OPTIONAL /
can be a separate follow-up; the core deliverable is the per-notebook root + fork-C
startup coordination.

External writes: none expected (purely local).
